table.retrieve:
Select 
	UserName=A.UserName, 
	CashServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty),
	CashServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount),
	CreditServiceQty = SUM(A.CreditServiceQty),
	CreditServiceAmount = SUM(A.CreditServiceAmount),
	TotalServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty) + SUM(A.CreditServiceQty),
	TotalServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount) + SUM(A.CreditServiceAmount),
	CashReturnQty = SUM(A.CashReturnQty),
	CashReturnAmount = SUM(A.CashReturnAmount),
	CreditReturnQty = SUM(A.CreditReturnQty),
	CreditReturnAmount = SUM(A.CreditReturnAmount),
	TotalReturnQty = SUM(A.CashReturnQty) + SUM(A.CreditReturnQty),
	TotalReturnAmount = SUM(A.CashReturnAmount) + SUM(A.CreditReturnAmount),
	NetServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty) + SUM(A.CreditServiceQty) - SUM(A.CashReturnQty) - SUM(A.CreditReturnQty),
	NetServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount) + SUM(A.CreditServiceAmount) - SUM(A.CashReturnAmount) - SUM(A.CreditReturnAmount),
	NetShare = SUM(A.commission),
	invflatdisc=MAX(A.invflatdisc),
	MiscCharges=MAX(A.MiscCharges),
	RoundingDiff=MAX(A.RoundingDiff)
From 
	(Select 
		UserName = dbo.Users.UserName,
		CashServiceQty = 
			(Select IsNull( SUM (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode IN (10) AND
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode) ,
		CreditServiceQty = 
			(Select IsNull( SUM (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode NOT IN (10) AND
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode) ,
		CashReturnQty = 
			(Select IsNull( Count (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode IN (13) AND 
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		CreditReturnQty = 
			(Select IsNull( Count (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode NOT IN (13) AND 
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		CashServiceAmount = 
			(Select IsNull( Sum (SH.InvTotal), 0 )
			From ServiceHeader SH
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode IN (10) AND 
				SH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		CreditServiceAmount = 
			(Select IsNull( Sum (SH.InvTotal), 0 )
			From ServiceHeader SH
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode NOT IN (10) AND 
				SH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		CashReturnAmount=
			(Select IsNull( Sum ( SRH.InvTotal), 0 )
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode IN (13) AND
				SRH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		CreditReturnAmount=
			(Select IsNull( Sum ( SRH.InvTotal ), 0 )
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode NOT IN (13) AND
				SRH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		commission = 
			(Select isnull(sum(srd.qty * (1 - srd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sh.discperc * 0.01) * (srd.commission - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode) -
			(Select isnull(sum(srd.qty * (1 - srd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - srh.discperc * 0.01) * (srd.commission - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRH.SalesManCode = dbo.Users.UserCode),
		invflatdisc = 
			(Select isnull(sum(flatdisc),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH	
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate) -
			(Select isnull(sum(flatdisc),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate),
		MiscCharges = 
			(Select isnull(sum(SH.MiscCharges),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH	
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate) -
			(Select isnull(sum(SRH.MiscCharges),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate),
		RoundingDiff = 
				(SELECT Value=ISNULL(SUM(T.Value), 0)
				FROM
					(Select Value=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(D.qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 0) - 	(ROUND(SUM(D.qty * D.price * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 2)), 0)
					From ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D
					Where H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND H.Date <= :ad_enddate
					Group BY H.ServiceInvCode, H.FlatDisc, H.MiscCharges
					UNION ALL
					Select Value=- ISNULL( ROUND(SUM(D.qty * (D.serviceprice - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 0) - (ROUND(SUM(D.qty * D.serviceprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 2)), 0)
					From ServiceRHeader H, ServiceRDetail D
					Where H.ServiceRInvCode = D.ServiceRInvCode AND H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND H.Date <= :ad_enddate
					Group BY H.ServiceRInvCode, H.FlatDisc, H.MiscCharges) T )
	From Users
	WHERE UPPER(Active)='Y') A
GROUP BY
	A.UserName
Order By 
	UserName

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: sum(netserviceamount for all) - invflatdisc + misccharges - sum(netshare for all)
